units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:9:1">Koh. R. to VII, 9</cite> (prov.) <he>היכמא דמ׳ עזיל על פלכתיה כן סליק ליה מפלכתיה</he> (not <he>בפ׳</he>; strike out <he>הוא נסיב</he>, being a Var. lect. or gloss to <he>סליק</he>) as the spinner winds (the yarn) on his distaff, so will it get off his distaff, i.e. the rash man hurts none but himself; v. <cite ref="C00777"><he>גִּיסָא</he> III</cite>.
